categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Dowell Science and Technology Inc. primarily operates in the fine chemicals manufacturing industry, focusing on leather chemicals, synthetic leather chemicals, and other polyurethane chemicals. The company also engages in the production and sales of multilayer engineered wood panels and plastic products. Additionally, it has divisions in intelligent manufacturing and chemical trading.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for leather chemicals, including bio-based, low-VOC, and chromium-free tanning agents. It develops waterborne polyurethane materials and high-performance coatings with environmentally friendly processes. The firm emphasizes R&D in green, low-carbon materials, functional additives, and intelligent manufacturing technologies to enhance product performance and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leather processing enterprises, synthetic leather manufacturers, automotive interior suppliers, furniture, footwear, and textile industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products used in leather goods, automotive interiors, clothing, and furniture decoration. Major customers include large leather product manufacturers and regional distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant presence in East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, and other regions. It has subsidiaries and sales offices in multiple provinces and cities, including Sichuan, Shanghai, Anhui, Guangdong, Hebei, and Zhejiang. Internationally, it exports to countries such as Vietnam, Ethiopia, Mongolia, Thailand, and has established a production base in Cambodia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Dowell operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of specialty chemicals used by downstream leather and synthetic leather manufacturers. It also engages in upstream raw material procurement and downstream technical service and application support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in green, low-carbon, bio-based, and environmentally friendly leather chemicals and synthetic leather materials. It focuses on developing non-formaldehyde tanning agents, solvent-free waterborne polyurethanes, chromium-free tanning technologies, and functional additives like waterproofing, anti-fouling, and odor reduction agents. Intelligent manufacturing and automation in production processes are also key strategic R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including leather chemicals, synthetic leather chemicals, polyurethane materials, and engineered wood panels. The company also earns income from technical services, application solutions, and trading activities. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distributor channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic leather chemicals market, recognized as one of the most comprehensive product providers in China. It competes with other specialty chemical manufacturers in the fine chemicals and leather chemical sectors. Its competitive advantages include a broad product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and a well-established sales network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 753 million, a 3.94% increase year-over-year, with chemical product sales growing 14.52%. Despite revenue growth, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 11.45 million, impacted by losses from divestiture of a wood products subsidiary and investment losses in associates. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.41 billion and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Dowell emphasizes its comprehensive product range covering the entire leather processing chemical chain, advanced environmentally friendly and bio-based materials, and customized technical solutions. Its strong R&D team and innovation in green chemistry and intelligent manufacturing provide customers with high-performance, low-VOC, and sustainable products. The company’s customer-centric approach and integrated service model enhance customer value and market competitiveness.
